subject: SOC 2 Type II report request — initial asks, bridge options, and delegation playbook
messages:
From: Claire Benson <security@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ron Snyder <ron.snyder@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for SOC 2 Type II package (audit period clarification)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this. Acme is preparing for our internal procurement review and legal needs confirmation that Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering calendar year 2026. Specifically we need:

- Confirmed audit period (start/end dates).
- A copy of the final SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok).
- A bridge letter if the final report doesn't fully cover our requested controls window.
- Minimal artifact list (policy snapshots, user access logs, change management evidence, and telemetry samples) to accompany the report.

Can you also indicate your preferred secure transfer method (SFTP, presigned S3, or secure Drive) and any embargo or retention constraints? We try to get this in the contract folder by EOD next Thu (2027-09-16).

If it helps, our auditors (ClearShield) can accept a bridge letter + artifacts and mark the file as provisional in our procurement queue.

Appreciate a quick confirmation and any standard reply templates you can share — our legal team sometimes re-requests evidence and having a template reduces churn.

Best,
Claire
Security Operations — Acme Cloud

Attachments: none

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Benson <security@acme.com>
Cc: Ron Snyder <ron.snyder@acme.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for SOC 2 Type II package (audit period clarification)

Claire —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers up front:

- Audit period covered: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 (SOC 2 Type II report completed and issued).
- We can provide the redacted report and a signed bridge letter if you need explicit language for a gap window — attach: SOC2-TypeII-Bridge-Letter-v1.docx.
- Preferred transfer: presigned S3 links are fastest for bulk evidence; we also support SFTP and a one-time shared Drive folder.

I attached a minimal evidence index (minimal-evidence-index.csv) showing typical artifacts we share for procurement audits: policy snapshots, sample access logs (redacted), change management ticket exports for the audit window, and representative telemetry excerpts. We keep telemetry samples small and redact PII by default.

Timeline: we can get the redacted report + bridge letter to you within 48 hours. Evidence bundle (if you want the minimal set) — 3 business days. If ClearShield needs direct read-only account access to an evidence collector, we can provision a time-limited role: "redwood-audit-readonly" for the ClearShield principal.

I'll loop in Karthik for artifact pulls and Marissa to coordinate secure transfer. Below I've pasted two short reply templates you can use when the procurement team asks for specifics.

---
Template A — short (for procurement UI):
"Redwood Inference has a SOC 2 Type II report for 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31. A redacted copy and bridge letter can be provided on request; secure transfer options include presigned S3, SFTP, or a shared Drive link."

Template B — detailed (for legal/controls review):
"Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (audit period 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31) is available in redacted form. We can provide a bridge letter addressing specific control coverage if required, along with a minimal evidence bundle (policy snapshots, access logs, change management exports, and representative telemetry samples). Evidence transfer can be completed via presigned S3 links (preferred), SFTP, or a one-time shared Drive folder. Contact security@redwood.com to request access or to arrange direct auditor access (time-limited, read-only role)."
---

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Bridge-Letter-v1.docx; minimal-evidence-index.csv

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II package request — delegation & evidence playbook (internal)

Team — forwarding Acme's request (below). Action plan and delegation checklist: please follow and confirm ownership by EOD today. We should aim to get the redacted report + signed bridge letter out within 48 hours, then the minimal evidence bundle within 3 business days.

Delegation playbook (short):
- Karthik: pull change-management ticket export (Jira filter: project=INFRA AND updated>=2026-01-01 AND updated<=2026-12-31). Export CSV and upload to the evidence bucket under /acme/ACME-3421/change-mgmt.csv. Note: remove internal-only columns (cost-center, salary info).
- Marissa: gather policy snapshots for 2026 snapshot dates (security, access-control, incident response). Save as PDF with header "policy-snapshot-2026-<policy>.pdf". Also copy SOC 2 Type II redacted report and sign the bridge letter (I'll sign after you get the doc).
- Evelyn: sample access logs — pull 3 representative days (peak, normal, low). Sanitize usernames to uid hashes, strip IPs if required by legal. Provide a README that explains how the samples were chosen.

Transfer & packaging notes:
- Use the evidence-collector sandbox (redwood-evidence-collector S3 prefix) for staging. We will create presigned S3 links with 14-day expiry and share with Claire and ClearShield.
- Include an evidence-index.csv (attached) with each filename and a 1-sentence description and date range.

Reply snippets to include with the package:
- "Attached: redacted SOC 2 Type II report (2026), signed bridge letter, and a minimal evidence bundle to support procurement review."
- "If you need additional artifacts beyond the minimal bundle, please let us know which control IDs are in scope and we will map artifacts to control families."

Please confirm assignment (reply-all) and estimate delivery ETA.

Vanessa

From: ClearShield Audit Team <audit@clearshield.com>

Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SOC 2 Type II package request — audit period and delivery options

Vanessa / Claire —

Thanks for the clarity. Confirming: ClearShield can accept the redacted report + bridge letter as provisional evidence for procurement. A few quick notes from the audit side to speed review: 

1) Audit period alignment: Confirmed 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 — that matches our scope.
2) Bridge letter: a signed PDF is sufficient; notarization is optional but not required for procurement purposes.
3) Evidence transfer: presigned S3 links (recommended) or SFTP are both fine. If you choose presigned S3, please include: a short README, evidence-index.csv, and redaction notes.
4) Minimal artifact expectations: policy snapshot dates, 3 days of access logs (redacted), change management CSV for the period, and a sample of operational telemetry (no raw user data).

Proposed delivery timeline: redacted report + signed bridge letter by 2027-09-10 EOD; minimal evidence bundle by 2027-09-13 EOD. If you can meet that, we will mark the procurement review as "materials received (provisional)" and proceed.

If you want ClearShield to ingest the evidence directly, open a ticket referencing SUP-ACM-879 and we will request read-only S3 credentials.

Regards,
ClearShield Audit Team
audit@clearshield.com

Attachments referenced: evidence-transfer-instructions.pdf
